units.missing_outcome_bounds: fraction unless a field explicitly ends_pp

generator_comparison.response_time_definition: Original per-attempt command_to_first_reference_wall_seconds; initial command to first executable reference, includes grounding/generation/transition setup; not model-forward-only time. Simulated time paused during offline generation.

controller_confirmation.endpoint: End-to-end execution; operational failures remain unsuccessful; rejected common anchors leave both arms unattempted.
controller_confirmation.test_name: Exact paired two-sided McNemar test; maximum8 comparisons with Bonferroni candidate alpha0.00625.
controller_confirmation.effect_interval_method: Paired-origin percentile bootstrap; resample complete origin pairs.

risk.loss_normalization: risk: available elements; future_onset/intervention: valid windows; residual: arm squared norm/available horizon-weight sum/sample; smoothness: time-sum/sample

residual.loss_normalization: risk: available elements; future_onset/intervention: valid windows; residual: arm squared norm/available horizon-weight sum/sample; smoothness: time-sum/sample

efficiency.units: Latency fields ending_ms are milliseconds; other time fields identify their own units.
efficiency.scope: Recorded learned-controller decisions on each arm's evolving trajectory; Risk inference is retained in both modes.
efficiency.percentiles: pooled raw recorded per-decision values; linear interpolation at(n-1)*p
